en.headline: Seven Hong Kong–Jakarta flights cancelled after Indonesian volcano eruption
en.dek: The Airport Authority said at least seven services between the two cities were cancelled by Sunday afternoon after ash from Anak Krakatau closed Jakarta’s main airport.
body: The Airport Authority Hong Kong said at least seven flights between Hong Kong and Jakarta had been cancelled as of 3pm on Sunday after Indonesia’s Anak Krakatau volcano erupted and forced Soekarno-Hatta International Airport to suspend operations.

Cathay Pacific and Garuda Indonesia cancelled multiple Hong Kong–Jakarta services scheduled for Sunday and Monday. Cathay Pacific told passengers holding Jakarta tickets issued before 5 September for travel on 5 and 6 September that they could rebook, reroute or obtain a refund without extra fees.

Indonesian authorities said volcanic ash led Jakarta’s main airport to halt flights for part of Sunday, affecting hundreds of services and tens of thousands of passengers across the network. Other airports on Java and Sumatra also suspended operations for periods during the day.
The Airport Authority advised travellers to check with their airlines for the latest timings. Anak Krakatau, in the Sunda Strait between Java and Sumatra, has been active in recent weeks.

zh.headline: 印尼火山噴發 至少七班香港雅加達航班取消
zh.dek: 機管局表示，截至周日下午三時，往來香港與雅加達最少七班航班因喀拉喀托之子火山噴發取消，國泰及印尼鷹航亦取消周日及周一部分班次。
body: 機場管理局表示，印尼喀拉喀托之子火山噴發後，雅加達蘇加諾—哈達國際機場一度暫停運作，截至周日下午三時，往來香港與雅加達最少七班航班取消。
國泰航空及印尼鷹航取消多班原定周日及周一來往兩地的航班。國泰向持有9月5日前開出、行程為5日及6日往來雅加達機票的乘客，提供免費改期、改道或退款安排。
印尼當局指火山灰導致雅加達主要機場周日部分時間停航，受影響航班數以百計。爪哇及蘇門答臘其他機場當日亦曾暫停運作。
機管局呼籲旅客向所屬航空公司查詢最新航班資料。該火山位於爪哇與蘇門答臘之間的巽他海峽，近周持續活躍。
